featured_reviews.name: Ashish Balachandran
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had one of the best experiences at Third Wave Coffee in Chowpatty, Girgaon. The highlight of this outlet is definitely the staff and their service.

👥 Service

The staff were extremely polite, prompt, and attentive. From taking the order to serving the drinks and food, everything was handled smoothly. The team was always available if we needed anything, and the service really made the experience pleasant.

🥤 Drinks
•	Strawberry Lemonade – Very refreshing with a good balance of sweetness and citrus. Perfect for a hot day.
•	Peach Bubble Tea – Quite enjoyable and flavourful. The peach taste was nice and the bubbles added a fun texture to the drink.

🍽️ Food
•	Bonanza Pizza – Slightly below average. The base and toppings were okay, but it didn’t really stand out compared to the drinks.
•	Chilli Cheese Toast – Absolutely fabulous. Crispy, cheesy, and perfectly balanced with just the right hint of chilli. Definitely one of the highlights of the meal.

🌿 Ambience

The ambience was fabulous. The café has a comfortable and relaxed vibe, making it a great place to sit, chat, or spend time with friends.

⭐ Final Verdict

While the Bonanza pizza could be improved, the drinks, chilli cheese toast, ambience, and especially the excellent service make this outlet stand out. Definitely one of the better Third Wave Coffee experiences in the Chowpatty–Girgaon area. ☕

Never would have imagined there would be such a hidden gem in the busy and rowdy streets of Crawford. This place was literally a hole in the wall, and it didn't appear very promising from the outside, especially since it was located in a run-down building, and on the first floor.

But the second we stepped into the cafe, the ambience turned into one of a classic, beloved, family owned cafe. In the middle of a busy weekend, we tried the mocha frappe, the latte, the araggato and some French fries.

The coffee was amazing, though lacking some typical sweetness, which was compensated with the sugars they provided.

There were seculded seating options, like a place you could run away to when the world gets too heavy. The owner was nice, and the servers polite. The place was clean, minimalistic and the music low, so you could study here too.

Would surely be coming back to this reasonably charged, beautiful place!!

featured_reviews.name: Naresh Shirodkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
A charming little café tucked near Girgaon Chowpatty that works perfectly as a pit stop after a walk along Marine Drive. HAV Coffee has that relaxed neighbourhood café vibe — minimal interiors, the aroma of fresh coffee in the air, and a menu designed around comfort bites and specialty beverages.

The coffee selection is where the café shines. The Spanish Latte is easily one of the more enjoyable picks on the menu — creamy, slightly sweet and well balanced, making it ideal for those who prefer their coffee on the indulgent side. The Salted Caramel Cappuccino also stands out with a pleasant balance between sweetness and espresso bitterness. If you’re in the mood for something more dessert-like, the Lotus Biscoff Milkshake is rich and decadent, while their classic cold coffee is a refreshing companion for Mumbai’s warm evenings.

On the food front, the menu leans toward light café plates and quick bites. The Chilli Cheese Toast is simple but satisfying with a nice crisp base and gooey topping. The Korean Garlic Bun offers a buttery, garlicky bite that pairs well with coffee, while the Avocado on Toast feels fresh and wholesome. The Nachos with salsa and sour cream make for an easy sharing snack if you’re visiting with friends.

For something slightly more filling, the Mexican Burrito Bowl brings together beans, rice and toppings for a hearty café-style meal, while the Cottage Cheese Steak with ratatouille and Green Thai Curry with rice offer continental and Asian options that round out the menu nicely.

Overall, the food and drinks here lean above average, with the beverages being the highlight of the experience. The café works especially well as a relaxed coffee stop before or after spending time by the sea.

A pleasant spot for coffee lovers and casual café bites in this part of South Mumbai.

"Dear Third Wave Coffee Team,

I wanted to take a moment to express my heartfelt appreciation for the exceptional service you provide. From the warm and welcoming ambiance to the consistently delicious coffee, every visit to your café is a delightful experience.

Your team's dedication to quality, attention to detail, and genuine hospitality never go unnoticed. It’s evident that you truly care about creating a memorable experience for your customers. Thank you for setting such high standards in service and coffee craftsmanship.

featured_reviews.name: Adv Surabhi Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a really disappointing experience here and honestly didn’t expect this level of service.

I ordered a strawberry matcha with almond milk and made sure to clearly repeat my order twice to the staff taking it. Despite that, what I received was nowhere close to what I asked for, it was literally like a strawberry milkshake. That’s not a small mistake; it completely changes the drink.

When it came to the matcha itself, it was even worse. The taste was completely off and felt very poorly put together. Instead of using something like real strawberry jam or compote, they seemed to have just added some artificial strawberry essence. It tasted synthetic and unpleasant, which completely ruined the matcha experience.

This isn’t just about taste. it’s about basic attention to orders and quality control. When you’re charging premium prices for specialty beverages, the least you can do is get the order right and maintain some standard in preparation.

Really disappointing overall. Definitely not the kind of experience you expect when ordering something as simple as a matcha.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi Surabhi,

We’re truly sorry to hear about your disappointing experience. This is certainly not the standard we aim to deliver, and we understand how frustrating it must have been to receive an incorrect beverage despite clearly placing your order. We regret that the drink did not meet your expectations in terms of both preparation and taste. Your feedback regarding the quality, ingredients, and overall experience is very important to us, and we take such concerns seriously. We would request that you share your order/contact details via the below link or write to care@thirdwavecoffee.in so that we can look into it. https://forms.office.com/r/hhDUDRi4MY

featured_reviews.review_text: Third Wave Café is an amazing spot with great coffee and a cozy vibe. The staff is friendly, service is quick, and the food is always fresh and tasty. Perfect place to relax, work, or hang out. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Had time to visit this  newly opened cafe located right below the Kemp's Corner flyover. This place is located inside the newly opened crossword store and offers a freshly prepared Coffee full of aroma and flavours with balance of sweetness and refreshing acidity. This place serves everything from Cappuccino to Frappe, from Pizza to Bannoffe. The ambience is also nice with store built keeping in mind the love for coffee and the brands simplicity. I had ordered hot cappuccino which had bold coffee taste with natural sweetness of milk and veg pizza which has crunchy base and loaded with jalapeno, onion toppings. Pros - Friendly Staff, Observant staff, Timely order acceptance.

featured_reviews.name: Kiara Soni
featured_reviews.review_text:
​⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Board Games & Brilliant Bites!
​If you are looking for a place with amazing fusion food, fantastic drinks, and a super fun vibe, this spot is an absolute winner. They even have board games to keep you entertained while you wait for your food!
​🍽️ What We Ordered:
​Mexican Beans with Paneer Tacos: A fantastic twist! The paneer went beautifully with the beans, and the fresh salsa and sour cream tied it all together perfectly.
​Steamed Bao with Crumbed Cottage Cheese Batons: This was a standout dish. The crunch of the sriracha-drizzled cottage cheese batons paired with the tang of the radish kimchi inside a soft bao was pure genius.
​Jalapeño Poppers: Golden, crispy, and oozing with flavor—the perfect crowd-pleasing appetizer.
​Lord of Mai Tai’s (Drink): Absolutely refreshing and beautifully crafted. It paired amazingly well with the spicy, flavorful food.
​🎲 The Vibe:
​Everything we tried was top-notch. The addition of board games makes it the perfect place to unwind with friends, play a few rounds, and enjoy an incredible meal.
​Highly recommended for your next weekend hangout!

featured_reviews.name: Sonnal Kkadu
featured_reviews.review_text: The café is located at a very prime spot near Marine Drive and is easily accessible on foot. While the staff wasn’t particularly warm or friendly, the food was decent. I tried the berry iced tea, which was quite refreshing and enjoyable. The pizza was okay. Nothing exceptional, but satisfactory overall.

featured_reviews.name: Jonah Jagadeshan
featured_reviews.review_text:
This random find on maps was a hit. Love the fact that it’s a cafe bar, full points for cafe vibes. There is no loud music, great food, service and could grab a small discount too.

We tried a bunch of different things and nothing was disappointing. And above all, it was one of the best LIITs I got recent times. I would highly recommend this place!

featured_reviews.name: Harry Smith
featured_reviews.review_text: The Cafe has plenty of space, the atmosphere is relaxed, stay for as long as you like feel comfortable and the food is really good. I went back 3 times to read, refresh and cool off. My favorites are the blueberry oatmeal, and fig smoothie. The oatmeal was especially good and something I'd like to learn how to make myself. Chandan kumar served me each time and is a very good host, providing a relaxing space i wanted to come back to. Also a very good ice cream place is around the corner natural icecream...

featured_reviews.name: Meeru
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm obsessed with this spot! It's my go-to destination, and for good reason. Every time I try something new, I discover another comfort food favorite. Whenever I'm at Marine Drive, I always end up here, because their mouthwatering, delicious food is irresistible. The service is consistently amazing, and it's become a staple for me - I've lost count of how many times I've visited! Whether I'm with friends, family, or flying solo, this place always delivers. Plus, they have a great selection of games, making it the perfect spot to hang out and enjoy incredible food. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Nidhi Tamboli
featured_reviews.review_text:
We randomly stepped into this café during heavy rain, and it turned out to be one of the best decisions! The ambience was extremely pleasant, peaceful, and calming, making it a perfect spot to relax and unwind. The service was warm and attentive, adding to the overall great experience.

We tried Garden Fresh Pizza, Peri Peri French Fries, Kaitlyn’s Pizza, Red Bull, Hot Chocolate, and Roasted Tomato Basil Soup – and everything was absolutely delicious. Each dish was well-prepared, flavorful, and satisfying.

This café is a wonderful place to spend quality time with friends or loved ones. The cozy corners, books, and games add a fun and homely touch, while the food and service make the whole experience even better. Whether you want a quiet, relaxed afternoon or a lively evening with good company, this spot fits both perfectly. Truly a blend of comfort, flavor, and warmth!

featured_reviews.name: Reneé Pereyra Elías
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nice place, good atmosphere.
The food was nice. It has a lot of options from foreign countries, like pizzas, pastas and burgers, which were not particularly appealing to me as a tourist because I wanted Indian food, but I presume this is how they target the local market. The Indian food choices were few but tasty. However, maybe the ratio quality: price wasn’t the best.
There was a nice selection of wines, which were good.
The atmosphere was nice.
Service was okay.
Very good location.

featured_reviews.name: BSai Ritesh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited The Cage Mocking Bird recently and had a really good time!
Drinks & Food: We tried their mocktails, which were super refreshing, especially the watermelon-based one. The bruschetta was also tasty and had a nice balance of flavors.
Ambience: The place has a very cozy and relaxed vibe, perfect for hanging out with friends late into the night.
Experience: One of the highlights is the number of board games and books available-you can just sit back, sip your drink, and play for hours. It makes the cafe feel warm, interactive, and different from most others.

Overall, a fun spot to chill with good food, games, and conversations. Definitely worth revisiting!

featured_reviews.name: Note & Navigate
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited on a weekend evening. This place has a charming old heritage feel with a cozy complete 90s vibe, making it quite unique compared to modern cafés. Do note that parking is not available, so visiting on weekends may require some planning.

They serve pure vegetarian food along with egg-based dishes only (no other non-veg). Their egg akuri is one of the popular items, and it was quite good. The menu is limited but decent — we also tried pizza, which was very average. They serve good beer, which pairs nicely with the nostalgic vibe.

One of the highlights is the amazing jukebox with a great music selection that really enhances the retro atmosphere. The staff is polite and helpful, making the experience pleasant.

Important tip: they accept cash only, no online payment options, so remember to carry cash.

Overall, a great spot to visit with your gang if you enjoy 90s vibes,old pop music ,the Himesh and Imran Hashmi era music, simple comfort food, and chilled beer. A fun place to relax and spend quality time.
There is waiting time too but we got the table in few minutes.

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Lenze
featured_reviews.review_text: Cafe Ideal is one of those places that feels frozen in time. Overlooking Chowpatty, it offers beautiful sea views, old-school Mumbai charm, and a relaxed atmosphere that's perfect for slowing down. The vintage décor and classic music add to the nostalgia, making it a great spot to sit back, enjoy a meal, and watch the city go by. Whether you're catching up with friends or spending some quiet time alone, the ambience is what truly makes this place special.

featured_reviews.name: Jinesh Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
The OG cafe ideal.this was on my list for a very very long time. It's a an old Parsi place( in terms of when it was established, the interior is mix of staying to true to a old Parsi cafe yet modern looking interiors) and almost like a landmark in the area.

I happened to servicey Harley close by and came here to kill 1-2 hours .

Food - ordered the chana garlic fry, it was good.
Ambience - really well done, try and get a table that helps you see the seashore, not a lot of mumbai restaurants have this feature.
Service - Very nice , they have old faithful folks and it shows in how they treat customers
One very important point - They only take Cash, no upi, no cc. ( Don't ask, it's beyond me, maybe to have a bit of tax advantage i guess )

Overall recommend this place. Will go there as a proper visit when in the area to try out their other dishes in their cafe .

Perfectly balanced with spices and moist enough with a creamy texture

Spacious seating with a vintage look, clean and hygienic washroom

All in all a nice place in a good location with the Irani cuisine that I like for breakfast

featured_reviews.name: priyak midder
featured_reviews.review_text:
Café Ideal at Girgaon Chowpatty enjoys a lovely location—right across the beach, with a relaxed, old-Bombay charm that’s perfect for a breezy evening meal. The vegetarian food is satisfying, and the menu offers a good variety for those looking to unwind by the sea.

We tried the mac and cheese pasta, akuri (spiced scrambled eggs), paneer bhurji, and a draft beer. The dishes were well-prepared and flavourful—simple comfort food done right. However, the experience was somewhat diminished by the reluctant staff and noticeably delayed service. Despite the place not being overly crowded, getting attention from the servers took repeated efforts, which took away from the otherwise peaceful vibe.

Overall, it’s a spot with great potential—ideal for a casual outing if you're not in a hurry. A little more warmth and efficiency from the staff could turn this average experience into something truly enjoyable.

featured_reviews.name: Anusuya
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Calm Vegetarian Haven in Kala Ghoda

Tucked away in the charming bylanes of the food area at Kala Ghoda Zen Cafe is a lovely vegetarian-only spot that offers a welcome break from the city's rush. The interiors are quaint with a warm relaxed vibe and the space is spread across two levels – a cosy ground floor and a quieter mezzanine level that’s perfect if you’re looking for a bit more privacy or calm.

The service is friendly and attentive which adds to the overall charm. The menu has plenty of interesting vegetarian options. We ordered the falafel wrap which was crunchy flavourful and left us wanting more. Light yet satisfying. The tomato pesto cheese sandwich was equally delicious – fresh and well made with comforting flavours.

And the cappuccino – really one of the highlights. Very very good. Smooth strong and creamy just the way a proper cappuccino should be.

Zen Cafe is the kind of place you’ll want to return to – for a peaceful solo break a quiet chat or simply to enjoy good food and coffee in a lovely tucked away corner of Kala Ghoda.

featured_reviews.name: SoulCranell
featured_reviews.review_text:
Atmosphere:
If I had to describe the vibe of Zen cafe it would be "cosy". The interiors make you feel really comfortable and you can just relax and enjoy your meal time with some magazines.

Food:
My orders were definitely not the typical "cafe order" since I had visited for lunch and was hungry, so I had to order a proper fulfilling meal. I had ordered, "Moroccan chickpea curry with rice" and I kid you not it was so delicious. It had that perfect home-cooked healthy meal vibe and to compliment it I had ordered fresh lime soda.

Service:
Since I had visited on a busy day, staff was very much occupied but still attentive. Overall 10/10 would recommend this place.

Tip: Make a prior reservation to save yourself from the hassle of waiting.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
“Zen Café, Colaba- where calm meets craft.
Tried their veggie sushi roll, croissant with hot chocolate, and couldn’t help but admire the cozy rustic vibe. The space feels effortlessly artistic — warm lights, wooden textures, and the aroma of fresh bakes wrapping you in peace. A perfect corner for slow mornings, deep thoughts, and good food that speaks less and feels more.”

featured_reviews.name: Sakshi Lawand
featured_reviews.review_text:
Tucked away in the artsy lanes of Kala Ghoda, Zen Cafe is a quiet escape from the city's chaos, a minimalist, calming space perfect for slow mornings, work sessions, or thoughtful conversations. With natural light pouring in, wooden accents, and an almost meditative vibe, the ambiance lives up to the name “Zen.”

The menu leans towards healthy, vegetarian fare with Mediterranean and global influences. Their open sandwiches, hummus plates, and freshly baked goods are flavorful and light. Coffee is excellent, smooth and well-balanced, and the cold brews are especially worth a try. Portions are moderate, and presentation is clean and understated.

Prices are on the premium side, but you're paying for both quality and the peaceful setting, a rarity in South Mumbai. Service is polite and unhurried, which works well with the relaxed pace of the cafe.

A perfect spot to read, write, or simply slow down for a bit, Zen Cafe is a hidden gem for anyone who values good food in a beautiful, uncluttered space.

featured_reviews.name: Anupriya Karande
featured_reviews.review_text: This is one of my most favourite cafés in the city & I always keep going back. It’s tucked in a quaint lane in Kalaghoda. Cozy vibes, sweet staff with great service & amazing food. Definitely try their platters, it’s value for money. My go-to order is always a Mocha with butter croissant 🥐☕️

Pair them with crispy potato twisters for the ultimate snack attack. Support this small family-run business—buy local and keep Colaba’s independent cafes thriving. Frequently recommended on Google reviews as one of Mumbai’s top spots for coffee and fries by tourists and locals.

featured_reviews.name: kalyani auti
featured_reviews.review_text: Very tasty food! We had Aubergine Teriyaki, Pepperoni Pizza, Fresh Lime Soda, Rosemary Fennel Lemonade and Chocolate Profiterole. The Aubergine Teriyaki is a must try! Amazing flavors with the nice texture of aubergine and black rice. The Rosemary Fennel Lemonade tasted amazing with it. The ambience is also good, nice jazz music. Good service as well.

featured_reviews.name: Suraj Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited Kala Ghoda Cafe during the Kala Ghoda Festival with friends, and what a find this place turned out to be. Tucked away inside a small lane, it’s a little difficult to spot. After the madness of the fest, this café felt like a lake in a desert, felt calm, comforting, and exactly what we needed.
The vibe is warm and lively at the same time, with a charming setup and even a hidden bar counter that adds to the character of the place.
Coming to the food and drinks, they are the absolute winners. I tried the Masala Cappuccino, and it was truly unique, with a lovely kick of masala chai flavours blended into the coffee. Something I’ve never had before and surprisingly addictive.
The Cheese Chilli Toast, recommended by the waiter, did not disappoint—super cheesy with perfectly crispy bread. The Cottage Cheese Burger was honestly to die for, easily one of the best vegetarian burgers I’ve had—flavourful, filling, and perfectly balanced.
And the real star of the show was the Hash Brown dish “Rosti, crispy on the outside, creamy on the inside, and just cooked to perfection. Absolute comfort food.
Overall, great food, lovely coffee, welcoming vibes, and a peaceful break from the festival rush. Kala Ghoda Cafe is definitely a place I’d keep coming back to.

featured_reviews.name: Diya D'Sa
featured_reviews.review_text: Cozy ambiance and great service! The server recommended the chili cheese toast and it did not disappoint—perfectly crisp, cheesy, and with the right amount of spice. The waffle was good as well, though it came with quite a bit of nuts, granola, and raisins (great if you enjoy that). With the fresh fruit, I didn’t even need the syrup. My favorites were definitely the cheese toast and the chai. I also picked up a bag of their coffee beans, which are perfect for making coffee at home or even garnishing espresso martinis.

featured_reviews.name: Paras Mhatre
featured_reviews.review_text: Kala Ghoda Café in Fort makes for a memorable stop. Service was decent, though it could be sharper. The food hit the right notes—the mushroom black rice risotto was warm and comforting, the four-cheese pizza hearty and fulfilling, and the carrot dish pleasantly fine. What truly elevates the experience is the café’s vibe and ambiance, which are simply noteworthy. Overall, a good outing worth revisiting!!!!!

featured_reviews.name: Betterwithbffs
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently visited this newly opened cafe @iteeha.coffee store in Mahalaxmi. This place has an amazing soothing ambience and I’m totally in love with it. Not only the ambience is comforting but the food is so good that you’ll be wanting more. We tried their Mac & Cheese which was exactly perfect for the quote don’t judge a book by its cover😂 It looked a little sad but honestly it’s one of the best mac & cheese I’ve ever tasted. The second was the Ham and Cheese sandwich, this is the dish that stuck in my mind. It’s super yummy and even after a few days of visit I’m still craving for more. The next was Butter croissant, it was flaky, crispy and loaded with butter. Chicken Quiche was our next choice. The pastry was perfectly golden and crispy and it’s definitely a good one. For beverages, we tried their House cold coffee with Vanilla bean ice cream, it’s definitely a must try for all those who love thick coffee shake. We even tried their Mocha which was also amazing. The staff even managed to convince us to try their new Orange Chilli Hot Chocolate which was something I was hesitant but honestly it was so good. The hot chocolate had the perfect orange zest and chilli spice. Everything was so well balanced. For the desserts we had their New York Cheesecake and it’s definitely one of the best I’ve had yet. In all it’s just a place you’d want to spend an evening at with relaxing ambience and good food. The staff was amazing making our meal perfect.

featured_reviews.name: Tanishka Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
My recent visit at this cafe totally has my heart. With great food and service this place is just a spot to relax. The vibe of this place is so peaceful and the ambience is just great. With a great subtle decor this place is absolutely gorgeous. Every corner of this cafe is Instagram worthy. We were served by Lloyd and Sashikant. They both were attentive and the service was quick. They even made sure every table and every part of the cafe is maintained clean.
Few items mentioned below are which I gave a try and would recommend it to all.
• Affogato Vanilla Coffee :- Basically it's an Italian dessert with a scoop of vanilla ice cream over which an espresso is poured. This combination is absolutely amazing and is enjoyed by every coffee lover. You either sip on it or have it with a spoon. The taste is strong and would definitely recommend it to everyone.
• Vietnamese Cold Brew :- This coffee is made using sweetened condensed milk instead of milk, sugar or any sweetner. This does taste very different and is something which you need to give it a try.
• Veg Quiche:- Quiche is basically a custard baked in a flaky pie crust shell. It's stuffed with various options and is enjoyed by every one. Here we tried is the veg quiche which had cheese and leek.
• Chicken Quiche :- Similar to the up one, only difference is it has chicken stuffing.
• Ham & Cheese Sandwich:- This one absolutely had my heart. Super super delicious crisp sandwich. The classic sandwich which never fails to amaze you.
• Classic Chicken Sandwich :- Great great filling absolutely different than we usually get and would anyday go for this one. Chicken lovers, this crisp amazing delicious Sandwich is worth a try.
• Chocolate Cake :- One of the best chocolate cakes I have had. Soft, melting in mouth this cake has my heart.

featured_reviews.review_text: Heard a lot about this place from reels, and was not disappointed. Went with 3 friends around 3:30 pm on 14th Feb. It was not crowded at all. Started with the Iced Filter Coffee, was a little watered down, but you can always ask for more coffee concoction. Then the Goli Bhaji and Mangalore Buns were absolutely delicious, not too sweet, perfectly balancing the sweetness with the coconut chutney. Then we got 4 different doses, and the Ghee Podi Benne Masala Dosa (jain) was the bestseller for a reason. First bite was heavenly and comforting, and the masala was made of raw banana, and was in sufficient quantity. The dosa was only so flavorful, there was no need of sambar or chutney. If you take regular dosa, you get an additional tomato garlic chutney. My friend ordered the Mulbagal Dosa, which they claim to have started the 1st time in Mumbai. Some might say you would get doses at cheaper prices elsewhere, but their price reflects their commitment to perfection and love towards serving people. I will definitely visit this place again..!!

featured_reviews.name: Meghna
featured_reviews.review_text:
We ordered :

Veg cheese momos:- Tasteless. Sauce given was mayo which doesnt suit with momos. Cabbage n liquid cheese was filled in it.

Vegan veg burger:- super dry burger. No sauces. Thin patty absolutely tasteless. No Cheese slice despite we told them to put.

Handi momos: It was 4 piece fried momos with super spicy mayo gravy topped over it. Can never eat this.

Sandwitch kulcha: it was two flat bread and inbetween super spicy same old paneer gravy stuffing. Placing was over small bed which was unique but item was totally failed.

Mojito : it was life savour. it bigtime Helped us in eating all this spicy fire food.

Whole wheat paneer cheese wrap:  same stuffing of paneer which was in all above items. Chillyflakes and garam masala in every stuffing made it impossible to eat.

We read review in mid day today and went to eat there but failed experience. There were just 3 tables. Its a small joint eatery very uncomfortable atmosphere no privacy to talk.

I dont recommend anyone after my experience.
Dont go on photos. They are misleading 😄

featured_reviews.name: Omkar Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
🤩I ordered Paneer Kurkure Momos Fried and Veg cheese burger 🤩

I would surely rate it 5 star ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Paneer kurkure momos was really very tasty and crispy as mentioned. 4 piece were available, size can be improved.

Schezwan sauce and Mayonese were provided.
Ingrediants were perfectly mixed with paneer 😍😋😋. It really tasted delicious and little spicy 😍

Veg cheese burger was damn cheesy and tasty.
The patty they used were delicious with tommato and mayonese added.

Sauce packet was shared with the burger.

Both Paneer kurkure momos and Veg cheese burger were packed seperatly 🤩

Packing was good with No spill

Food was tasty and main thing there were variety of menu from which you can order.

I will surely order more from here and would suggest to try PANEER KURKURE MOMOS FRIED ❤️

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Supal
featured_reviews.review_text:
ATTENTION ! ATTENTION ! ATTENTION !

Are you craving for something more delicious and at pocket friendly price..
Here we go, recently we visited to a place known as @handichaa which is 2 min away from Grant road Railway station. They serve the best handi Maggie and chai.

We absolutely loved their
Italian Maggie:-
Maggi made with veggies and Mayo sauce. With load of cheese. Maggie was absolutely delicious and also you should definitely try it out when you visit handi chaa.

Handi Chai:-
First ever handi chaai in South Mumbai. This chaai has a strong taste of adrak and many herbs. If your are a chaai lover you will loved this chaai. It has a amazing flavour.

Veg Cheese Burger:-
It has Pattie, veggies and Cheese. It was really so tasty. The aloo tikki was cruchy and lip smacking. The sauces add a great taste to it. It was mouth watering burger and it fulfilled our stomach.

Note:- Here the owner has gave us challenges that to taste burger and if we didn't like he will pay us back. The kind of confidence and passion for cooking is great.

You can also order you Favourite food at Price worthy. Great taste, Great quantity and great quality. Their service is also prompt. I would highly recommend to all Food lovers and share your experiences when you visit or order.

Location📍:-
63,naushir bharuchi marg,
Near Gomantak,Grant road Railway station
Grant road (west)

Time:- 2 pm
